

Little utils on top of `Litellm` library.

## Installation

To in stall run the commands below.

``` sh
pip install "git+ssh://git@github.com:ssslakter/lite-utils.git"
```

or

``` sh
pip install "git+https://github.com/ssslakter/lite-utils"
```

## Usage

``` python
import time
from lite_utils.core import run_many_chats, Chat, h2str


chat = Chat("gpt-4o-mini", sp ="Answer only in emojis")


async def coro(chat: Chat, item):
    await chat(item)
    return chat.h

t1 = time.time()
# run chats in parallel
# filter function will skip some items before calling coroutine
res = await run_many_chats(coro, ['say hello', 'say goodbye', 'hi!'], chat, filter_fn=lambda x: '!' not in x)
t2 = time.time()
print(f'{(t2-t1):.2f} sec')
```

      0%|          | 0/3 [00:00<?, ?it/s]

    0.01 sec

### Formatted output

``` python
print(h2str(res[0]))
```

    **user**: 
    say hello
    **assistant**:
